notes.title: Survive Into Night "Rest In Pieces" Update - Version 1.0.9
notes.content:
[b]Rest In Pieces Update[/b]

- New Weapons & Craft Items!
- Game play balancing and quality of life improvements!
- New Zombie AI behaviours
- New Hidden Areas to discover!
- Cleaned up & reduced install files!
- New environmental objects & tweaks
- New Achievements!
- Improvements to Horde Mode

The Rest in Pieces update adds many new ways to fight against the Undead in both the Survival Horror Story mode and the Endless Wave Horde mode! Lots of new features to check out, and many hidden areas across the open world to explore!

Enjoy & Stay tuned for future updates!

notes.title: Survive Into Night Halloween Horde Update
notes.content:
With Horde Mode here this update adds the ability to build Wood Barricades that can be placed and moved around to fortify the openings in your base from waves of Undead! There is also a number of important tweaks that improve weapons, maps, and many other elements of the game. Sound improvements & balancing and much more - Version 1.08 makes Survive Into Night even better, and just in time for Halloween!

New Item/Craft: Wood Barricade 
Weapon balancing improvements
Environment & Map tweaks
Devils of Night enemies stats & skills adjusted
New Zombie death effects
Improvements/changes to HUD and Menu elements
Audio balancing & improvements
Halloween settings added

notes.title: Survive Into Night version 1.07 - Horde Mode Update
notes.content:
Devlog 1.07 Horde Mode Update-------------------------------------------------------------------
- All New "Horde Mode" game mode is now available!
- Audio balancing improvements
- New death sequence for player

Horde Mode is here, take a step away from the games haunting Story Mode and step into the arena to face endless waves of the Undead! Between waves gather loot and upgrade your arsenal and player perks to survive as long as possible. More updates with lots of new content, features, and improvements will be coming every week!

notes.title: Survive Into Night version 1.06 Update
notes.content:
Development Log 1.06 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Tweaks to enemy procedural generations & stats
Tweaks to weapon stats & durability
Changes to Day/Night cycle and impact on environment
Changes to player breathing & stamina effects
Map & building changes/improvements
Improved tutorials system
Back end work on Horde mode - Coming this Halloween!

Make sure to check out all of the new weapons & quests - The game now has Chainsaws, FreezeRays, and lots of new items to craft! As always if you enjoy the game please consider leaving a review as it really helps! The big Halloween update is coming soon!

notes.title: Survive Into Night version 1.0.5 Update Notes
notes.content:
[b]Development Log 1.05 ---------------------------------------------------------[/b]
Character Class system! (Choose from 4 classes with unique advantages/disadvantages)
New Craft: Medkit (Fully restores max HP and fully heals HP)
New Craft: Silent Green (Fully restores max SP, Max HP +5, Quench thirst +5)
Zombies have new behaviours and procedurally generated stats.
New Achievement: Headshot Master (Complete 50 Headshots)
Various tweaks to improve gameplay balance
Improvements to audio balancing

notes.title: Survive Into Night version 1.0.4
notes.content:
[b]Development Log version 1.0.4:[/b]
- New Weapon/Craft: Chainsaw!
- Crafted Items now automatically go into inventory if not already full
- New animations for Zombies
- Various improvements to sound effects & background music
- Improvements to collision systems
- NPC AI Improvements
- Minor changes to weapon physics

Another update to Survive Into Night! Like all updates there is a fun new weapon to craft and test out against the Undead. You can craft the Chainsaw now and start trimming off some heads and limbs. Zombies have been animated and feel more "alive" then ever before! In addition to that there have been many improvements to the game itself to make the entire experience better all around.

Stay tuned for more updates in the coming weeks including the character class system & endless wave Horde mode. If you enjoy this update and the game please consider leaving a review!

Enjoy and keep surviving!

notes.title: Survive Into Night version 1.0.2
notes.content:
Development Log --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Brand new Weapon/Craft: Freeze Ray Blaster
Active slot now changes to fists automatically after weapon breaks
Tweaked procedural generation of loot spawns
Enemies no longer attack/follow player while game is paused
Game now autosaves after completing any story objectives
Various quality of life improvements
Normalized sound effects that were to loud/quiet
Fixed bug that prevented the game from starting in full screen mode
Fixed bug where low thirst would hurt/kill player while in menus/inventory
Fixed various audio bugs
